services.title: RV Surge Protectors
services.text: Recreation vehicles today have multiple electronic circuit boards, and many campgrounds, fairgrounds and park pedestals are incorrectly wired. A surge protector guards against improper electrical power and reduces the risk of damage to the RV's electronic systems.
points: Reverse polarity, open neutral and open ground protection

Digital display of voltage, current, frequency and error codes

about.title: We want to be Pearland's most referred electrician.
text: Warfield Electric is an electrical contracting company specializing in residential and commercial electric service and construction. Our primary focus includes residential and commercial electrical service repair, commercial lighting services, new tenant build-outs, lease spaces, parking lot lights, panel change outs, breaker replacement and installation, generator installation, surge suppression systems, commercial and residential remodeling and electrical troubleshooting. And for fun, we offer underwater fishing lights, also known as green lights.

Do you ever wonder where the service went in your electric service call? Have you ever called for electrical service and then weren't sure you wanted to let the electrician in the door? You should expect your electrician to be knowledgeable, service oriented, punctual and polite, not to mention reasonably priced.

Our business is built on your repeat business and your referrals, and we want you to be satisfied. We are licensed and insured, and many electrical service calls can be made the same day. Warfield Electric is a full service electrical contractor serving Houston, Clear Lake, Seabrook, Pearland and the surrounding areas.

It depends what is in it. Federal Pacific Electric made circuit breakers from the 1950s into the 1980s, and electricians and inspectors found they did not provide adequate protection for the electrical service. Zinsco panels are largely obsolete today but are still in older homes, and a modern house draws much more power than they were built for. When either one overheats or a breaker fails to trip, it can become a fire or shock hazard. If you have one, have it looked at.

faqs.q: Why should an RV have a surge protector?
faqs.a: Recreation vehicles have multiple electronic circuit boards controlling various systems in the rig, and those systems are vulnerable to the power surges and voltage fluctuations common in today's campgrounds. In our experience many campgrounds, fairgrounds and park pedestals are incorrectly wired.

facts.heading: Federal Pacific Panels
facts.text: A New Jersey state court ruled in a class action lawsuit that Federal Pacific Electric violated the Consumer Fraud Act, because the company knowingly distributed circuit breakers that were not tested to meet UL standards. When a breaker fails to trip, the current coming into the panel cannot be turned off once it flows through the lines, and it keeps flowing until it exhausts itself or the wires melt, so the panel can overheat and start a fire.

facts.heading: Choosing A Backup Generator
items: Portable gas engine generators cost between $300 and $2,500 and provide 2,500 to 10,000 watts, but you have to start them, refuel them and keep them away from the house because of carbon monoxide
Standby generators cost between $2,000 and $9,000, provide 20,000 to 45,000 watts with unlimited running time, and must be installed by a professional electrician
Decide what you need before the power goes out rather than after

facts.heading: More On The RV Surge Protector
items: AC frequency protection shuts down source power if it deviates more than 9 hertz from 60 cycles per second
A surge indicator error code shows when the protector's own circuit has been damaged and needs replacing
A previous error code readout tells you why power was last interrupted
A manual bypass passes source power through if the computer fails, without disabling the surge protection
Microprocessor controlled, and owners can get a free upgrade processor by returning the old one if the software changes
